action: The runestone rises from the snow with a rumble, its blank face shimmers with cold teal light, then it stands steady with frost mist drifting. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: RUNESTONE: a tall standing grey granite runestone with a rounded top set in snowy ground, a carved interlaced knot border and a smooth blank face in the middle, frost on its edges, faint muted aurora-teal cold light rising from its base. Palette: frost off-white, glacier blue, slate grey, pine green, muted aurora teal, leather brown, antique bronze. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Norse winter folk style: carved wood and stone, pine and birch, falcon feathers, fur and leather, bronze, physical snow and ice (not glowing crystal). NOT anime, no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no letters, no runes, no text, no Viking horned helmets, no valknut, no religious or political symbols, no wolves, no character, no person, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are frost off-white, never pure white.
